summary: Phase 2 (Pembayaran Reguler + Pengingat) testing complete. 16/16 new pytest backend tests pass (100%) covering CRUD, process idempotency, catch-up of past dues, isActive/autoCreate gating, reminder sort, no _id leakage, and Phase 1 regression. Frontend: all requested testIDs found and functional via mobile viewport (390x844) — drawer entries, screens, modals, form creation, IDR formatting (Rp54.000), Aktif/Nonaktif toggle, edit prefill, Otomasi section in Pengaturan with nav to both screens, Phase 1 sanity intact.

minor.issue: Reset only wipes transactions/accounts/categories — does NOT clear the new `recurring` and `reminders` collections. Phase 2 records survive a reset, which is inconsistent with the documented behavior of `/data/reset` and creates stale data after a wipe.

react_native_issues.issue: Pre-existing console warnings (shadow*, pointerEvents, transform-origin, useNativeDriver) carried over from Phase 1. Cosmetic; no functional impact.

action_items: (Minor) Update POST /api/data/reset to also `db.recurring.delete_many({'userId': USER_ID})` and `db.reminders.delete_many({'userId': USER_ID})` for full cleanup.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~730 lines — approaching the 700-line guideline. Phase 3 should consider splitting Phase 2 routes/models into separate modules.
_advance_date handles monthly clamping correctly (e.g., Jan 31 -> Feb 28) and yearly leap-year (Feb 29 -> Feb 28). Verified by passing tests.
process_recurring loop guard set to 60 iterations prevents infinite loops if startDate is far in the past — sensible.
All Phase 2 endpoints exclude `_id` via projection and `_clean()`. No leakage observed in any GET/POST/PUT response.
Pydantic Literal types enforce frequency/repeat enums on input — good.
Reminders sort=date uses ascending dateTime as required.
seed_data_creation: Test data created during testing: 1 TEST_Langganan Netflix recurring (monthly, Tunai/Kuota, 54000), 1 TEST_Bayar Listrik reminder + a few TEST_R* reminders from backend tests, plus 1 TEST_Paused recurring (from backend test). NOTE: POST /api/data/reset does not clear these — main agent may want to manually drop the `recurring` and `reminders` collections, or call DELETE for each via API, to start the user demo with a clean slate.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 2 tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_phase2.py. Reuses the `api` and `clean_state` fixtures from conftest.py. BASE_URL comes from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. All frontend testIDs documented in the review are present and functional. When testing recurring/reminders UI, be aware that POST /api/data/reset does NOT clear these collections — either DELETE existing items per id before testing, or drop the collections directly in MongoDB. The first card returned by GET /api/recurring is sorted by nextDueDate ascending, so the *first* toggle/edit button in the DOM may not belong to the most-recently-created item — select by data-testid suffix=id when needed.
rca_of_issue: Minor reset gap RCA: /app/backend/server.py:542 `reset_all_data` was authored in Phase 1 and was never updated to delete the new Phase 2 collections (`recurring`, `reminders`) added later in the same file. Fix is a 2-line addition before the `await seed_defaults()` call.
